description: User balance: personal real wins 10/15/20... roll once; 3% per exclusive combat trait, 91% none. Fog personal victory grants ego/temper rate +5 each.

edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START COMBAT_TRAIT_CHECKPOINT_ROLL | 2026-10-19_combat_trait_probability
 ! Existing wins remain cumulative. Only 10,15,20... wins draw once for an unassigned trait.
 dynamic 'jo9_trait_combat_wins = <<$args[1]>>["jo9_real_wins"] & jo9_trait_combat_class = <<$args[1]>>["jo9_combat_trait"]'
 if jo9_trait_combat_wins >= 10 and jo9_trait_combat_wins mod 5 = 0 and jo9_trait_combat_class = 0:
  jo9_trait_combat_roll = rand(1,100)
  if jo9_trait_combat_roll <= 3:
   dynamic '<<$args[1]>>["jo9_combat_trait"] = 1'
  elseif jo9_trait_combat_roll <= 6:
   dynamic '<<$args[1]>>["jo9_combat_trait"] = 2'
  elseif jo9_trait_combat_roll <= 9:
   dynamic '<<$args[1]>>["jo9_combat_trait"] = 3'
  end
 end
 ! JO9 MOD END COMBAT_TRAIT_CHECKPOINT_ROLL

! JO9 MOD START COMBAT_TRAIT_ROLL_CLEANUP | 2026-10-19_combat_trait_probability
 killvar 'jo9_trait_combat_wins'
 killvar 'jo9_trait_combat_roll'
 ! JO9 MOD END COMBAT_TRAIT_ROLL_CLEANUP
 killvar 'jo9_trait_combat_constitution'

! JO9 MOD START FOG_VICTORY_GROWTH_SLAVE | 2026-10-19_combat_trait_probability
   if $итог_боя = 'победа':
    slave_rate['ego'] += 5
    slave_rate['temper'] += 5
   end
   ! JO9 MOD END FOG_VICTORY_GROWTH_SLAVE
   dynamic $replace($dyn_calc_slave_attrs, 'dyn'+'slave', 'slave')

! JO9 MOD START FOG_VICTORY_GROWTH_ASSISTANT | 2026-10-19_combat_trait_probability
   if $итог_боя = 'победа':
    assistant_rate['ego'] += 5
    assistant_rate['temper'] += 5
   end
   ! JO9 MOD END FOG_VICTORY_GROWTH_ASSISTANT
   dynamic $replace($dyn_calc_slave_attrs, 'dyn'+'slave', 'assistant')
